subject: Physics
note: 2021 AQA Physics Paper 3 optional Section B Medical physics only: 35 marks. The student's full Paper 3 is the compulsory Section A (45 marks) PLUS exactly ONE selected optional Section B (35 marks) for 80 total, not a sum of all Section B options. Metadata only, no exam question stems or complete mark scheme copied.
markingWarnings: 01.1 and 01.2 are distinct four-mark explanations with linked scientific justifications, not bare keyword matching.
01.3 is supported by a supplied photomultiplier schematic; correct explanation must distinguish stages of electron multiplication.
01.4 grants error-carried-forward for specified intermediate half-life and decay calculations and a conclusion consistent with the calculation.
02 requires identifying medical scans from three supplied images AND explaining relevant visual evidence; cannot be safely marked from a plain-text guess alone.
03.1 includes intermediate geometric and intensity calculations with error-carried-forward for later stages.
04.1 requires a figure-based similar-triangles calculation; official source allows equivalent geometric methods.
04.2 allows distinct relevant explanations up to the two-mark cap.
05.1 is a one-mark option, must not turn into a multiple-point rubric.

05.2 is a six-mark LEVELS-OF-RESPONSE question incorporating ray diagram and reasoning; marking requires overall best-fit level, not six independent ticks, and is not fully automatable from plain text.
verification: Source-first audit of original AQA November 2021 7408/3BB question paper, final mark scheme and PDF page screenshots. Q01=15, Q02=4, Q03=5, Q04=4, Q05=7, sum35. Editorial skill topics are new paraphrases. Do not claim these references are ready-to-answer practice questions.
